spec.text: Operating margin fell **1.8 pts** to **14.2%** in Q3. About two thirds of the fall came from freight costs in the North region, which rose after the July carrier change.
Operating margin fell **1.8 pts** to **14.2%** in Q3.[1] Freight per order rose 22% after the July carrier change,[2] and the North region carried most of it.[3]
Operating margin fell **▼ 1.8 pts** to **14.2%**. Gross margin held at **38.1%** ▲ 0.1 pts, so the fall sits below the gross line, in freight.
